title: Pay Toward Bankruptcy
excerpt: Pay Toward BankruptcyATTENTION BANKRUPTCY CLIENTS You may NOT pay your bankruptcy fee with a credit card or the Pay Later option, as that debt will be discharged in the bankruptcy. You may only pay with a debit card or an eCheck, or a third party may pay with a credit card on your behalf.

blocks.html:
ATTENTION BANKRUPTCY CLIENTS

You may NOT pay your bankruptcy fee with a credit card or the Pay Later option, as that debt will be discharged in the bankruptcy. You may only pay with a debit card or an eCheck, or a third party may pay with a credit card on your behalf.

I Understand
